Part 1 (missing fund column): Debt Service (87,691) and Lottery Fund (28,010) have no schedule; added from p4, detail transfers out = 132,149 + 87,691 + 28,010 = 247,850. Part 2 (different basis): detail records gross transfers in General 109,503 (p8) + Street 136,509 (p9) = 246,012, which the Total column nets: 247,850 - 246,012 = 1,838. Remaining difference after the fix 1,838 - 247,850 = -246,012 = the netted governmental transfers in; not an error.
